verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone left the gutter
uncleaned again — small leaves
holding what light they can

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A cat pauses there,
watching the puddle break
into a hundred suns

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I sweep the porch clean
before I've decided
what I'm keeping this year

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Not the boxes still taped shut,
not the name half-erased
from the mailbox — just this broom,
this patch of morning I can reach

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Even the dust resettles
by evening — I've stopped
trying to keep it out
motifs: giving up on a small task

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the door left open
not for anyone to come in
just to feel the air change

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a moth finds the lamp
before I do — some things
still know what they're looking for

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
I sweep the same corner
twice, three times, calling it
patience, calling it home

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the kettle clicks off
and I let the silence sit there
before I pour anything

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the tea leaves settle
at the bottom of the cup —
I read nothing into it, mostly

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the window fog clears
where I breathed on it — my own
warmth, showing me the street

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a bird lands on the sill
studies me through the glass
then decides I'm harmless

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the crumbs I left out
gone by morning — proof enough
I wasn't watched for nothing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the kettle clicks off
steam still rising into nothing—
I let it be smoke, not sign

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
no crumbs left tonight
just my hand on the cold sill
learning to wait empty
